cover.concept: A single accent-orange thread entering from the left, splitting in the middle into many fine muted-indigo lines that fan out to small geometric tiles of different sizes, then converging again on the right into one bright accent-orange point. The fan is airy and precise; the final point is calm and solid.

inline.name: one-prompt-many-searches
inline.concept: One speech-bubble outline in muted indigo on the left, from which five thin lines branch out to five small rounded tiles stacked on the right. Four tiles stay pale and quiet; the one reached by the finest, most precise line glows solid accent orange.

inline.name: one-page-one-decision
inline.concept: One tall page shape in muted indigo outline at center, with a single bold accent-orange line running from top to bottom through it like a clear decision path. Around it, several faint, empty page outlines recede into the background, unmarked and pale.
